title: Cohomological support and amplitude of an object of a derived category
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category with derived category $D(\mathcal C)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and for $r\in\mathbf Z$ let $H^r:D(\mathcal C)\to\mathcal C$ be the $r$-th cohomology functor (the cohomology $\ker d^r/\operatorname{im}d^{r-1}$ of a representing complex, well defined since quasi-isomorphisms induce isomorphisms on it). For $K\in D(\mathcal C)$ the *cohomological support* of $K$ is the set of integers

$$
 \operatorname{Supp}_{\mathrm{coh}}(K)=\{r\in\mathbf Z: H^r(K)\text{ is not a zero object of }\mathcal C\}.
$$

For integers $a\le b$, $K$ has *cohomological amplitude in* $[a,b]$ when $\operatorname{Supp}_{\mathrm{coh}}(K)\subseteq[a,b]$; equivalently $K\in D^{\ge a}(\mathcal C)\cap D^{\le b}(\mathcal C)$ for the canonical t-structure, i.e. $H^r(K)=0$ for $r<a$ and for $r>b$.
